summary: Focused preview verification found the new panel renders and old draggable endpoint dots are gone, but the move-start side of the approved tap flow does not persist. API proof shows PUT /connections ignores from_item_id/from_item_type, so moving a connection START from one pole/item to another cannot work end to end. No relevant testing skill found.

critical.issue: ConnectionUpdate only allows to_item_id/to_item_type/waypoints/connection_type. Frontend sends from_item_id/from_item_type for Move start, but the backend drops those fields and returns/persists the original start endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: In Playwright, actual mouse/locator click on the .conn-hit-line midpoint did not select the line; dispatching a DOM click did select it. This may indicate the wide hit-line click target still needs human/device self-test.

integration_issues.flow: Edit Lines & Connections -> select line -> Move start -> tap different item -> reload
integration_issues.issue: Move start does not update backend or persist; final connection from_item_id remained the original item after target tap/reload. API probe reproduced the same because backend ignores from_* updates.

action_items: Add from_item_id and from_item_type to backend models.connection.ConnectionUpdate and verify PUT persists start-endpoint updates.

Endpoint visual dots are non-interactive in JobMap JSX, so the old draggable-dot snap-back path appears removed; the remaining blocker is persistence for Move start.

rca_of_the_issue: Frontend implements Move start by calling handleConnectionUpdate with {from_item_id, from_item_type}, but backend ConnectionUpdate schema omits those fields. Pydantic ignores them, so PUT returns 200 with unchanged from_item_id/from_item_type; after reload the line appears snapped back at the original start. Repro: create/select a connection, click Move start, choose a different pole/UG item, then GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/connections shows the original from_item_id still stored.
